verdict.rationale: Productboard's own marketing says it automatically detects insights in feedback and links them to feature ideas, and that it surfaces critical feedback trends and new opportunities with citations for each finding. This covers the core of AI-assisted synthesis and opportunity discovery. However, the evidence is homepage-level only, and no item explicitly describes AI decluttering such as deduplication, clustering or noise reduction, or ranking opportunities by impact. Missing for 10: explicit AI-driven decluttering or deduplication of raw feedback, documented impact-based ranking of opportunities, in-depth first-party docs, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can use AI to declutter raw feedback and surface the most impactful opportunities

citations.quote: Productboard automatically detects insights within feedback that can be linked to related feature ideas.
Understand critical feedback trends and act fast on new opportunities. Productboard includes citations for every finding, so decisions are always backed by evidence.
Productboard's built-in agent handles all the information synthesis
